'''Nefarith, "Bonekrusher"''' is a [[Boss enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|Thanks to Nefarith, the "Bonekrushers" became a byword for terror in the Civilization Band. Her brutal conquest has not yet ended, and her true ambitions have not yet been revealed.}}
